description: Aeropuerto Internacional de Tocumen - Movimiento mensual de aeronaves is a series of datasets listed in Panamanian national open data portal (datosabiertos.gob.pa), an open data portal, published or maintained by Tocumen Aeropuerto Internacional de Panamá. Total de entradas y salidas de aeronaves por mes en 2019 clasificadas por su tipo de operación. Coverage: Panamá. The portal lists 28 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Tocumen Aeropuerto Internacional de Panamá. Its tags are aeronaves, entrada de aeronaves por mes en 2019, salida de aeronave por mes en 2019. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2024-06-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-pa-portal.
